subject: Approval request: SkyHarbor combined trial credits + discount for POC
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: SkyHarbor — request for combined credit + discount (POC)

Team — quick background and ask. SkyHarbor (Alex Porter, Maya Singh) are a 200-person logistics SaaS provider; they've run a 2-week eval and want to expand the POC to an 8-week proof of concept across two workflows (inference + reranking). They are close to committing but need help on economics to move the procurement process this quarter.

Current ask from customer: 8-week extension, $40k in free inference credits, plus a 15% discount on first-year list pricing. Their procurement team said this concession would let them sign a PO by mid-November.

Why I recommend approval:
- Deal ARR potential: ~$220k ARR first year (conservative).
- Strategic fit: they are in our target logistics vertical and referenced two integrations they want that we can promote as reference work.
- Technical: Ben confirmed the POC scope and baseline token volumes — the credit request maps to expected consumption.

I propose a blended concession: $30k trial credit + 10% first-year discount, conditional on a signed PO committing to 12 months within 60 days after POC close. If we can get exec signoff we will attach a short MOA and updated quote (included).

Attachments: SkyHarbor_MutualActionPlan_v3.pdf, Quote_SkyHarbor_RDW-2391.xlsx

Asks: Sean — can you greenlight the blended concession as written (or advise threshold)? Aditya — any legal/partner constraints we should be aware of? Ben — confirm the technical guardrails to limit overrun (rate limits, KV cache config).

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SkyHarbor — request for combined credit + discount (POC)

Naomi — confirmed. Technical notes:
- Scope looks accurate for the two workflows; expected token consumption for 8 weeks at the requested scale is ~28M tokens (we estimated ~32M at peak). $30k credit covers that with ~10% buffer if we enforce the rate-limit hook.
- We'll enable a hard cap on the trial project and provision dedicated endpoints for the POC to avoid noisy neighbors. I'll add the rate-limit policy to the mutual action plan.
- One ask: we should limit the discount to only the first 12-month commitment (no rolling discount beyond that). Also recommend a usage threshold in the PO (e.g., minimum monthly commit after conversion) to avoid churn risk.

I attached a small zip with POC tech notes: POC_Technical_Specs.zip (attachment stub).

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Porter <aporter@skyharbor.com>, Maya Singh <maya@skyharbor.com>, procurement@skyharbor.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2026 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Extension details and pricing — SkyHarbor POC

Alex / Maya — thanks again for the productive call today. Per our discussion, we can propose the blended concession below to the exec team: 

- 8-week POC extension
- $30,000 trial credit applied to the POC project
- 10% off first-year subscription list pricing (applies to the initial 12-month contract signed within 60 days of POC close)
- Condition: signed PO committing to a 12-month term at the agreed price within 60 days, plus a minimum monthly usage floor (to be specified in the PO).

Ben will enforce a hard cap on POC consumption and provide the technical acceptance criteria in the mutual action plan. If procurement is aligned, I will request final authorization from my director (Sean) today so we can issue an updated quote and DocuSign.

Would appreciate confirmation from procurement on the PO timing and the minimum monthly usage figure they are comfortable with.

Best,
Naomi
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SkyHarbor — request for combined credit + discount (POC)

Naomi — thanks for the clear write-up. A couple of quick checks before I authorize: 
1) Margin impact: finance looked at the $30k credit + 10% discount and flagged ~28% first-year gross margin on the deal at the conservative ARR you quoted. With the strategic upside (reference + vertical), I'm willing to approve if we: 
   a) Limit the credit to POC-only usage and claw back unused credit if we don't get PO within 60 days.
   b) Require a minimum 12-month commitment with a $5k/mo minimum usage floor after conversion (we can be flexible on structure but want a minimum economic guarantee).
2) Contract terms: legal wants the discount explicitly timeboxed to the first contract year and not to be automatically extended.

If those conditions are acceptable to SkyHarbor, I approve the blended concession. Naomi — please get procurement's confirmation and send me the redlined PO/DocuSign link.

Sean Gallagher
VP, Global Sales, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
From: Alex Porter <aporter@skyharbor.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya@skyharbor.com>, procurement@skyharbor.com
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Extension details and pricing — SkyHarbor POC

Naomi / Ben — thanks. Procurement is aligned with the proposed conditions. They ask that the PO reflect: the $30k credit applied to the POC project, the 10% first-year discount, the 12-month commitment with the $5k/month minimum floor, and the 60-day signed PO window. We can sign as soon as we get the updated quote and DocuSign link.

Two quick notes from our side: we would like a brief SLA (uptime and incident response) documented for the POC endpoints, and Ben's team to confirm the hard caps in writing.

If you can circulate the DocuSign today, procurement will prioritize review.

Best — Alex
Alex Porter
Head of Product, SkyHarbor Systems
aporter@skyharbor.com
